name: The Vanguard Pro Heavy-Duty Tactical & Industrial Utility Uniform Suite
description: Engineered from 1000D Cordura® reinforced ripstop flex weave with DuPont Teflon™ stain & water-repellent finish. Features articulated knee & elbow armor pockets, 14 multi-tool utility cargo pockets, heavy-duty YKK brass zippers, and reinforced triple-needle stitching for severe industrial and field duty.

name: The Apex-Core Antimicrobial Four-Way Stretch Medical Scrub Suite
description: Tailored for surgical teams and clinical healthcare professionals with Silvadur™ antimicrobial silver-ion fabric technology. Features fluid-resistant four-way stretch micro-twill, 9-pocket ergonomic utility cargo scrub pants, and breathable mesh ventilation panels for 24-hour shift comfort.

name: The Executive Artisan Double-Breasted Culinary & Chef Uniform Coat
description: Master-crafted from 240 GSM organic ring-spun cotton twill with dual CoolVent™ breathable back air-flow panels. Includes stain-release coating, concealed magnetic apron-stay collar tab, dual sleeve thermometer pockets, and handcrafted cloth knot buttons.
